headline: Angelina Jolie's Foundation Shields 150,000 Cambodian Forest Acres
meta_description: A foundation backed by Angelina Jolie has protected over 150,000 acres of Cambodian forest for two decades, where endangered elephants and pangolins thrive.
summary_short: Angelina Jolie's foundation has guarded 150,720 acres of Cambodian forest for 20 years. Rangers removed 4.8 miles of illegal snares in 2025 alone.
body:
Angelina Jolie's foundation has protected 150,720 acres of Cambodian forest for two decades, creating a sanctuary where elephants and pangolins continue to roam safely.

The work on the ground remains demanding and vital. In 2025 alone, rangers working to enforce protection across the forest removed more than 4.8 miles of illegal snares—traps set by poachers targeting the region's most vulnerable wildlife. This ongoing effort reflects the daily reality of conservation: success depends not on headlines, but on persistent, unglamorous work.

The two-decade commitment represents a rare long-term vision in environmental protection. By maintaining continuous ranger presence and active removal of poaching equipment, the foundation demonstrates that large-scale forest preservation requires sustained investment and vigilance.
quick_facts: 150,720 acres of Cambodian forest protected for 20 years
Elephants and pangolins still roam the protected territory
Rangers removed 4.8+ miles of illegal snares in 2025
